notes:
Summary:
- Customer: mid-size integrated health system (inpatient EMR + ambulatory docs). Heavy PHI footprint (notes, labs, imaging reports).
- Primary goal: enterprise RAG/retrieval for clinician-facing search + automated chart summarization. Focus on precision via reranking and embeddings.
- Indexing scale: planning ~250M documents (clinical notes, radiology reports, pathology), ~1.8-2.2B embeddings. Expect steady-state ingest 3-5M documents/month for 12 months.
- Latency/throughput targets: 95th pctile <250ms for single-doc search; bulk batch reranking throughput target 200 qps during peak for triage workflows.
- Cost sensitivity: target < $0.002/query average for clinician lookups; willing to pay premium for guaranteed SLOs and private networking.
- Model preferences: open Llama-3 style family fine-tuned for clinical medical terminology, quantized kernels preferred. Want fallback routing to smaller models during load.
- Security/compliance: PHI everywhere -> must have VPC/private control plane or on-prem deployment; strict token-level audit logs, immutability for audit events, KMS/HSM integration, SSO/SAML with SCIM provisioning, retention controls and e-discovery hooks. Data residency: US only for patient data.
- Integration needs: bi-directional replica with existing search infra (Elastic) for index provenance, connector to EMR (FHIR-lite export), audit webhook to SIEM.
- POC ask: 2-week private POC on Dedicated cluster in customer VPC, ingest 5M doc sample, validate 95p latency and token audit trail, run reranking A/B against current Elastic baseline.
- Quote from CISO: "We need cryptographic proof of access logs — not just console views."
- Tech concerns raised: network egress for embeddings during model fallback; desire to avoid cross-region fallbacks due to PHI.
- Jira stubs: RINF-4782 (POC infra setup), RINF-4829 (audit-logging feature questions).
- Drive: umbria-security-deck (security answers), poc-plan (ingest map + validation metrics).
- Emails: thread:1758245901 contains cost model; thread:1758245902 includes legal redline to contract.
